name: guest
title: Guest browsing
summary: Use the app without an account (App Store 5.1.1(v)): public content works, account-only actions open a sign-in sheet, account-only routes reached by deep link show a sign-in prompt, and account-only requests are answered locally instead of sent.
when: The app has accounts and any content or feature that is not account-based.
screens: | — | Sign-in required | sheet | any account-only action by a guest | — | sign in / cancel | — | — |
claudeRules: Account-only screens are wrapped in `withAccount(Screen, 'feature')` (`src/modules/account-gate`); every entry point calls `slots.useRequireAccount()('feature')` first. Never call `useCurrentUser()` from a guest-reachable component.
